name: viral-hyper-agent
description: A social media team for one creator. Give it a niche: a multi-source trend radar finds what's breaking out, a Style DNA extractor measures the best examples (caption font, size, colours, position, pace, hook, edit) and re-applies that caption style to your footage, and a script forge writes in your own voice, scored as speech and swipe-tested on a simulated viewer panel. Plus every platform's version, approved scheduling and a learning loop.
